page.overview:
Who is Sabrina?

Sabrina, also known by her title The Master of Psychic Pokémon, is a character debuting in Pocket Monsters Red and Pocket Monsters Green. She is the Saffron City Gym Leader and, hence the title she bears, is an adept user of -type Pokémon. Sabrina is fought in the Saffron City Gym, where she gives the Marsh Badge to Trainers who defeat her in a Pokémon battle. She possesses psychic abilities and specializes in -type Pokémon.

Sabrina is a slender young woman of medium height. She has long black hair with shorter layers around her face and a fringe and small reddish-purple eyes. She wears a small red and dress black in the middle at the waist with a slit on the sides with yellow cuffs over black tights/leggings, white gloves and red and yellow knee-high boots.

In Pokémon HeartGold Version and Pokémon SoulSilver Version, Sabrina has shorter navy hair, now around shoulder length, wears a tight-fitting spaghetti strap pink crop top that shows off her midriff and shoulders, white slim fit ultra low-rise pants (which reveals her hips and some area above) attached with a black belt with a silver colored hexagonal belt buckle below her hips and pink slip on shoes. She also wears green and black bracelets on her wrists that glow on certain sections.

Sabrina appears in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! with a similar outfit, but her dress has black sleeves and an X is added, she also wears green boots.
